$comment: Single source for the capture list. tools/gen-capture.mjs turns it into the table in STORYBOARD.md and into capture.sh (run both with --write; --check fails when they drift). `commands` are debug-ctl commands without the leading `ctl`; {out} becomes the output PNG path. Every ctl command here is taken from README.md (Build / test) and scripts/screenshots.sh, and was checked against Sources/NachoCombo/AppDelegate.swift on origin/main f684d41; none has been run against a real build yet.
build: Shoot from a v0.13.0 (or newer) debug build: widget window with the settings panel on the right. Re-read the README ctl section against that build first.
scale: 2x (the ctl snapshot commands write 2x PNGs). minWidth is the smallest width in pixels the renderer accepts without a warning.

captures.what: The six System Monitor menu bar items (CPU, memory, disk, network, sensors, battery) on sample numbers
captures.privacy: Sample numbers only; the strip contains no other app icons, clock or account menu.

captures.what: The app icon, read from the repository at render time (not copied, not a capture)
captures.privacy: Brand artwork; rights are reserved by Mafianacho (TRADEMARKS.md). Used here for the company's own promo of its own app.

captures.what: The widget window with the gadget wall, no panel open
captures.privacy: Sample data on (setup). The wall tiles show live values (Clipboard History rows, Device Control output name, Calendar Clock event, File Shelf items, Nacho Pet's sign-in button, Computer Use permission state): check every tile in the PNG and hide a tile with the widget edit mode if it shows anything real. Window title bar only; no desktop around it.

captures.what: The same window with the right-hand panel open on Calendar Clock, Settings tab (same window size as wall-home so the two overlay exactly)
captures.privacy: Calendar Clock must show sample events only (setup: gallery sample on); the wall tiles beside the panel carry the same live values as wall-home: check them too.

captures.what: Window Snap panel, Shortcuts tab, same window size
captures.privacy: Shortcut list only; shows which other app already holds a key only if one does - none on a clean test Mac.

captures.what: Window Snap panel, Permissions tab, same window size
Window Snap picture: a window snapped to the left half and one dragged to the right edge (the app draws the desktop around it)
captures.privacy: Drawn by the app on a made-up desktop.

captures.what: System Monitor picture: menu bar items above the CPU panel, sample numbers
captures.privacy: Sample numbers; no process names from the real Mac (sample mode).

captures.what: CPU panel with the CPU chart card hovered and its flyout beside it, sample numbers
captures.privacy: Sample numbers; the top-process list must show sample names only.

captures.what: Capture Float picture: dashed selection over a chart and the captured area floating with close, pin and share buttons
captures.privacy: Drawn by the app; the chart is a stand-in picture.

captures.what: File Shelf picture: a file dragged onto the floating shelf holding a PDF, an image and a text snippet
captures.privacy: Sample item names only; check the file names in the picture.

captures.what: Focus Dim picture: one window bright in front, two dimmed behind (light variant reads better)
captures.privacy: Drawn by the app; the app windows named in the picture are made up (Notes, Mail, Calendar) with no content.

captures.what: Disk Map window on the made-up sample disk, sunburst view colored by folder
captures.privacy: `disk sample` is a made-up disk: no real folder names. Wait ~1 s after `disk sample` before the snapshot.

captures.what: Combos page with the Desk combo selected (the whole page; the video crops the top)
Menu bar quick panel, tool list (Combo row first, status dots)
captures.privacy: Only the popover is captured, not the menu bar. Sample data on.

captures.what: Menu bar quick panel, combo screen
Nacho character, idle face (mascot only), read from the repository at render time
captures.privacy: Character artwork only: no chat, no login screen, no conversation.

captures.what: Nacho character, happy face (mascot only), read from the repository at render time
